summary: Lee called for a ceasefire and an end to military action against Palestinian families in Gaza in October 2023, and by 2025 was amplifying calls for U.S. recognition of Palestinian sovereignty. He endorsed Tom Steyer in 2026 explicitly to oppose AIPAC influence. CAIR Action endorsed him; Vote for Peace rated him an Ally. His only related legislative action was an abstention on AB 715, the antisemitism-coordinator and classroom-materials oversight bill.
